Entries.Text: Create at Point

Set up a part or region, then click in the viewport to place it. The first click puts a marker on the surface under the cursor, and a click on the marker creates the object there. Clicking elsewhere moves the marker, so a double-click places and creates in one go. Press Escape to stop placing.
Target Map
The map to create the object in.
Load a map, or pick a loaded one, to create objects in.
Pick a sub type to set up its properties.
A {0} could not be created.
Base Type
The kind of map object to create. Only parts and regions have a position to place.
Part
Create a part, such as an enemy or an asset.
Region
Create a region, such as a spawn point or a trigger volume.
Sub Type
The type of part or region to create.
None
Changing the type starts its properties afresh.
Placement
How the object is placed and named.
Height Offset: %.2f m
Raises (or lowers) the object above the clicked point, along the world's up axis.
Keep Placing
Keep placing after an object is created, so several can be placed in a row.
Name Automatically
Give each object a name the map doesn't use yet. Parts are named after their model (with a unique instance ID for Elden Ring and Nightreign), and regions after their type.
The name the object is created with.
Random Rotation
Give each created object a random rotation, so repeated placements don't all face the same way.
Apply Random Rotation
Add a random angle, within each chosen axis's range, to the rotation set in the properties.
X Axis
Y Axis
Z Axis
Randomise the rotation around the {0} axis.
%.1f deg
The minimum and maximum angle, in degrees, added around the {0} axis.
Actions
Place the object in the viewport.
Click in the viewport to place the point.
Click the marker to create the object, or elsewhere to move it.
Nothing was under the cursor to place the point on.
Created {0} in {1}.
Place in Viewport
Start placing: click in the viewport to put down the point, then click it again to create the object.
Create at Point
Create the object at the placed point.
Cancel
Stop placing and clear the point.
Point
The world position the object will be created at, before the height offset.
Drag or type to adjust the point.
No point has been placed.
Properties: {0}
The properties each created object starts with. The position comes from the clicked point.
Reset Properties
Set the properties back to the type's defaults.
Copy from Selection
Take the properties of a selected object of the same type.
